summary: We have developed a tool for researching potential sites for permanent bases—analogous to those envisioned for the Moon and Mars—by analyzing a wide range of terrestrial features. These include geological and mineralogical characteristics, surface materials, terrain, elevation, slope, surface roughness, craters, and other topographical details; environmental factors such as temperature, illumination, and extreme conditions; the presence of water, ice, permafrost, and other potential resources; atmospheric or surface processes like dust, wind, and erosion; as well as biological aspects—such as extremophiles, habitability, and potential biosignatures—and subsurface formations like caves and lava tubes. This system was created to address the challenge of finding locations that meet the specific requirements for various types of research; it identifies sites on Earth that align with the characteristics necessary for permanent bases on the Moon or Mars. It serves as a practical tool for mid-level research projects, analyzing diverse parameters, facilitating comparative assessments (Earth-Moon or Earth-Mars), and streamlining the work for researchers.
details: Our project identifies locations on Earth that resemble potential permanent bases on the Moon or Mars, evaluating their characteristics and examining their similarities and differences. It provides data that can be utilized in space-Earth research and contributes significantly to the exploration of diverse regions across our planet. The intended impact of the project is to offer a helpful and practical system. Our team employed HTML for the development of this system. We believe our project is as creative as it is practical, as it focuses on exploring regions that have either never been studied before or have only been examined superficially. We ensured that our presentation slides and website remain consistent and mutually supportive; the website not only identifies specific locations but also provides detailed analyses and evaluations, which serve to highlight the similarities and differences between these terrestrial sites and locations in space (on the Moon and Mars).
